name: code-review
about: A lead on opus with a correctness and a security reviewer; reads, reports, changes nothing
mission: Review {target} for correctness bugs, security problems and missing tests, and report findings ranked by severity.
done_when: one written report lists every finding with file, line, severity and a suggested fix, and no file was changed
constraints: report file and line for every finding

name: bugfix
about: One coding agent fixes the bug and proves it with a test; a reviewer checks the diff
mission: Fix this bug in {target}: find the cause, fix it, and add a test that fails without the fix.
done_when: the new test fails before the fix and passes after it, the existing tests still pass, and a reviewer has read the diff
constraints: smallest change that fixes the cause
work on a branch, do not push

name: research
about: A lead on opus with researchers who gather sources in parallel and one written answer
mission: Research {target} and write up what is known, what is disputed and what is still open, with sources.
done_when: one written summary answers the question, cites a source for every claim and marks what could not be verified
constraints: cite a source for every claim
mark what could not be verified

name: docs-pass
about: A technical writer brings the docs in line with the code; a cheap editor proofreads
mission: Bring the documentation for {target} in line with what the code does now, and fix what is missing or wrong.
done_when: every command, flag and file the docs mention exists and behaves as described, and an editor has proofread the changes
